verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַן יְהוָ֥ה אֶת־ אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an Yah·weh ’eṯ- ’î·yō·wḇ way·yō·mar
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Job . . .
verses.literalPt: RESPONDEU mais o SENHOR a Jó, dizendo:

verses.original: הֲ֭רֹב עִם־ שַׁדַּ֣י יִסּ֑וֹר מוֹכִ֖יחַ אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַעֲנֶֽנָּה׃פ
verses.transliteration: hă·rōḇ ‘im- šad·day yis·sō·wr mō·w·ḵî·aḥ ’ĕ·lō·w·ah ya·‘ă·nen·nāh
verses.literal: Will the faultfinder contend with the Almighty Let him who argues with God give an answer
verses.literalPt: Porventura o contender contra o Todo-Poderoso é sabedoria? Quem argüi assim a Deus, responda por isso.

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַן אִיּ֥וֹב אֶת־ יְהוָ֗ה וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an ’î·yō·wḇ ’eṯ- Yah·weh way·yō·mar
verses.literal: Then Job answered the LORD . . .
verses.literalPt: Então Jó respondeu ao SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: הֵ֣ן קַ֭לֹּתִי מָ֣ה אֲשִׁיבֶ֑ךָּ יָ֝דִ֗י שַׂ֣מְתִּי לְמוֹ־ פִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hên qal·lō·ṯî māh ’ă·šî·ḇe·kā yā·ḏî śam·tî lə·mōw- p̄î
verses.literal: Behold I am insignificant How can I reply to You I place my hand over my mouth
verses.literalPt: Eis que sou vil; que te responderia eu? A minha mão ponho à boca.

verses.original: אַחַ֣ת דִּ֭בַּרְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה וּ֝שְׁתַּ֗יִם וְלֹ֣א אוֹסִֽיף׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥaṯ dib·bar·tî wə·lō ’e·‘ĕ·neh ū·šə·ta·yim wə·lō ’ō·w·sîp̄
verses.literal: I have spoken once but I have no answer twice but I have nothing to add
verses.literalPt: Uma vez tenho falado, e não replicarei; ou ainda duas vezes, porém não prosseguirei.

verses.original: וַיַּֽעַן־ יְהוָ֣ה אֶת־ אִ֭יּוֹב מִנ סְעָרָה וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an- Yah·weh ’eṯ- ’î·yō·wḇ min sə·ʿå̄·rå̄h way·yō·mar
verses.literal: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind and said
verses.literalPt: Então o SENHOR respondeu a Jó de um redemoinho, dizendo:

verses.original: אֱזָר־ נָ֣א כְגֶ֣בֶר חֲלָצֶ֑יךָ אֶ֝שְׁאָלְךָ֗ וְהוֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·zār- nā ḵə·ḡe·ḇer ḥă·lā·ṣe·ḵā ’eš·’ā·lə·ḵā wə·hō·w·ḏî·‘ê·nî
verses.literal: Now brace yourself like a man I will question you and you shall inform Me
verses.literalPt: Cinge agora os teus lombos como homem; eu te perguntarei, e tu me explicarás.

verses.original: הַ֭אַף תָּפֵ֣ר מִשְׁפָּטִ֑י תַּ֝רְשִׁיעֵ֗נִי לְמַ֣עַן תִּצְדָּֽק׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’ap̄ tā·p̄êr miš·pā·ṭî tar·šî·‘ê·nî lə·ma·‘an tiṣ·dāq
verses.literal: Would you really annul My justice Would you condemn Me to justify yourself?
verses.literalPt: Porventura também tornarás tu vão o meu juízo, ou tu me condenarás, para te justificares?

verses.original: וְאִם־ זְר֖וֹעַ כָּאֵ֥ל׀ לָ֑ךְ וּ֝בְק֗וֹל כָּמֹ֥הוּ תַרְעֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- zə·rō·w·a‘ kā·’êl lāḵ ū·ḇə·qō·wl kā·mō·hū ṯar·‘êm
verses.literal: Do you have an arm like God’s Can you thunder with a voice like His
verses.literalPt: Ou tens braço como Deus, ou podes trovejar com voz como ele o faz?

verses.original: עֲדֵ֥ה נָ֣א גָֽא֣וֹן וָגֹ֑בַהּ וְה֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר תִּלְבָּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ḏêh nā ḡå̄·ʾōn wā·ḡō·ḇah wə·hō·wḏ wə·hā·ḏār til·bāš
verses.literal: Then adorn yourself with majesty and splendor and clothe yourself with honor and glory
verses.literalPt: Orna-te, pois, de excelência e alteza; e veste-te de majestade e de glória.

verses.original: הָ֭פֵץ עֶבְר֣וֹת אַפֶּ֑ךָ וּרְאֵ֥ה כָל־ גֵּ֝אֶ֗ה וְהַשְׁפִּילֵֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·p̄êṣ ‘eḇ·rō·wṯ ’ap·pe·ḵā ū·rə·’êh ḵāl gê·’eh wə·haš·pî·lê·hū
verses.literal: Unleash the fury of your wrath look on every proud man and bring him low
verses.literalPt: Derrama os furores da tua ira, e atenta para todo o soberbo, e abate-o.

verses.original: רְאֵ֣ה כָל־ גֵּ֭אֶה הַכְנִיעֵ֑הוּ וַהֲדֹ֖ךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: rə·’êh ḵāl gê·’eh haḵ·nî·‘ê·hū wa·hă·ḏōḵ rə·šā·‘îm taḥ·tām
verses.literal: Look on every proud man and humble him trample the wicked where they stand
verses.literalPt: Olha para todo o soberbo, e humilha-o, e atropela os ímpios no seu lugar.

verses.original: טָמְנֵ֣ם בֶּעָפָ֣ר יָ֑חַד פְּ֝נֵיהֶ֗ם חֲבֹ֣שׁ בַּטָּמֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: ṭā·mə·nêm be·‘ā·p̄ār yā·ḥaḏ pə·nê·hem ḥă·ḇōš baṭ·ṭā·mūn
verses.literal: Bury them together . . . in the dust imprison them in the grave
verses.literalPt: Esconde-os juntamente no pó; ata-lhes os rostos em oculto.

verses.original: וְגַם־ אֲנִ֥י אוֹדֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי־ תוֹשִׁ֖עַ לְךָ֣ יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- ’ă·nî ’ō·w·ḏe·kā kî- ṯō·wō·ši·a‘ lə·ḵā yə·mî·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Then I will confess to you that your own right hand can save you
verses.literalPt: Então também eu a ti confessarei que a tua mão direita te poderá salvar.

verses.original: הִנֵּה־ נָ֣א בְ֭הֵמוֹת אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂ֣יתִי עִמָּ֑ךְ חָ֝צִ֗יר כַּבָּקָ֥ר יֹאכֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- nā ḇə·hê·mō·wṯ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śî·ṯî ‘im·māḵ ḥā·ṣîr kab·bā·qār yō·ḵêl
verses.literal: Look at . . . Behemoth which I made along with you He feeds on grass like an ox
verses.literalPt: Contemplas agora o beemote, que eu fiz contigo, que come a erva como o boi.

verses.original: הִנֵּה־ נָ֣א כֹח֣וֹ בְמָתְנָ֑יו וְ֝אֹנ֗וֹ בִּשְׁרִירֵ֥י בִטְנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- nā ḵō·ḥōw ḇə·mā·ṯə·nāw wə·’ō·nōw biš·rî·rê ḇiṭ·nōw
verses.literal: See . . . the strength of his loins and the power in the muscles of his belly
verses.literalPt: Eis que a sua força está nos seus lombos, e o seu poder nos músculos do seu ventre.

verses.original: יַחְפֹּ֣ץ זְנָב֣וֹ כְמוֹ־ אָ֑רֶז גִּידֵ֖י פַחֲדוֹ יְשֹׂרָֽגוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yaḥ·pōṣ zə·nā·ḇōw ḵə·mōw- ’ā·rez gî·ḏê p̄a·ḥă·ḏō yə·śō·rā·ḡū
verses.literal: His tail sways like a cedar the sinews of his thighs are tightly knit
verses.literalPt: Quando quer, move a sua cauda como cedro; os nervos das suas coxas estão entretecidos.

verses.original: עֲ֭צָמָיו אֲפִיקֵ֣י נְחוּשָׁ֑ה גְּ֝רָמָ֗יו כִּמְטִ֥יל בַּרְזֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ṣā·māw ’ă·p̄î·qê nə·ḥū·šāh gə·rā·māw kim·ṭîl bar·zel
verses.literal: His bones are tubes of bronze his limbs are rods of iron
verses.literalPt: Os seus ossos são como tubos de bronze; a sua ossada é como barras de ferro.

verses.original: ה֭וּא רֵאשִׁ֣ית דַּרְכֵי־ אֵ֑ל הָ֝עֹשׂוֹ יַגֵּ֥שׁ חַרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hū rê·šîṯ dar·ḵê- ’êl hā·‘ō·śōw yag·gêš ḥar·bōw
verses.literal: He is the foremost of God’s works only his Maker can draw the sword against him
verses.literalPt: Ele é obra-prima dos caminhos de Deus; o que o fez o proveu da sua espada.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ ב֭וּל הָרִ֣ים יִשְׂאוּ־ ל֑וֹ וְֽכָל־ חַיַּ֥ת הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה יְשַֽׂחֲקוּ־ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḇūl hā·rîm yiś·’ū- lōw wə·ḵāl ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh yə·śa·ḥă·qū- šām
verses.literal: The hills yield him their produce while all the beasts of the field play nearby
verses.literalPt: Em verdade os montes lhe produzem pastos, onde todos os animais do campo folgam.

verses.original: תַּֽחַת־ צֶאֱלִ֥ים יִשְׁכָּ֑ב בְּסֵ֖תֶר קָנֶ֣ה וּבִצָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ- ṣe·’ĕ·lîm yiš·kāḇ bə·sê·ṯer qā·neh ū·ḇiṣ·ṣāh
verses.literal: He lies under the lotus plants hidden among the reeds of the marsh
verses.literalPt: Deita-se debaixo das árvores sombrias, no esconderijo das canas e da lama.

verses.original: יְסֻכֻּ֣הוּ צֶאֱלִ֣ים צִֽלֲל֑וֹ יְ֝סֻבּ֗וּהוּ עַרְבֵי־ נָֽחַל׃
verses.transliteration: yə·suk·ku·hū ṣe·’ĕ·lîm ṣi·lă·lōw yə·sub·bū·hū ‘ar·ḇê- nā·ḥal
verses.literal: The lotus plants conceal him in their shade the willows of the brook surround him
verses.literalPt: As árvores sombrias o cobrem, com sua sombra; os salgueiros do ribeiro o cercam.

verses.original: הֵ֤ן יַעֲשֹׁ֣ק נָ֭הָר לֹ֣א יַחְפּ֑וֹז יִבְטַ֓ח׀ כִּֽי־ יָגִ֖יחַ יַרְדֵּ֣ן אֶל־ פִּֽיהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hên ya·‘ă·šōq nā·hār lō yaḥ·pō·wz yiḇ·ṭaḥ kî- yā·ḡî·aḥ yar·dên ’el- pî·hū
verses.literal: Though the river rages Behemoth is unafraid . . . he remains secure though the Jordan surges to his mouth
verses.literalPt: Eis que um rio transborda, e ele não se apressa, confiando ainda que o Jordão se levante até à sua boca.

verses.original: בְּעֵינָ֥יו יִקָּחֶ֑נּוּ בְּ֝מֽוֹקְשִׁ֗ים יִנְקָב־ אָֽף׃
verses.transliteration: bə·‘ê·nāw yiq·qā·ḥen·nū bə·mō·wq·šîm yin·qāḇ- ’āp̄
verses.literal: Can anyone capture him as he looks on or pierce his nose with a snare
verses.literalPt: Podê-lo-iam porventura caçar à vista de seus olhos, ou com laços lhe furar o nariz?
